subject: Silver Oak Capital (silveroakcapital.co.uk) - how third parties describe its clients and process: client types, fees, speed, enquiry-to-completion steps, introducer/partner programme, lender calculator / developer scorecard tools
method: WebSearch only (direct fetch blocked). Facts recorded only from search-tool summaries and result titles/URLs. Own-site pages used only where the search summary cited them; flagged as 'OWN-SITE' in source. Verbatim strings are copied from the search summaries as given; where the summary paraphrased, 'verbatim' is empty.

facts.fact: CLIENT TYPES (third party): Property Week Commercial Property Awards 2026 organisation listing describes Silver Oak Capital as a specialist debt advisory firm serving property investors, developers and high net worth individuals.
facts.source: Property Week - Commercial Property Awards 2026 organisation page (via WebSearch summary, query 1)
facts.verbatim: specialist debt advisory firm providing tailored funding solutions for property investors, developers, and high net worth individuals

facts.fact: CLIENT TYPES - FOREIGN INVESTORS (third party): Letting Agent Today trades-directory listing positions the firm as helping foreign investors obtain prime residential or long-term commercial mortgages.
facts.source: Letting Agent Today trades directory (via WebSearch summary, query 1)
facts.verbatim: perfectly positioned to assist foreign investors looking to secure a prime residential mortgage or a long term commercial mortgage

facts.fact: CLIENT TYPES - EXPATS: No source surfaced that targets expatriates as a separate client category (search summary explicitly noted this). Foreign nationals / international clients are mentioned; 'expats' as a label is not.
facts.source: WebSearch summary, query 1 (negative finding)
facts.verbatim: I found no source that specifically targets expatriates as a separate category.

facts.fact: POSITIONING: Described as a London-based debt advisory and mortgage broker that is not a high-street mortgage broker but offers bespoke solutions for larger, more complex real estate transactions.
facts.source: WebSearch summary, query 1 (attribution mixed: 'its own materials and third-party listings' - treat as partly OWN-SITE)
facts.verbatim: does not operate as a high street mortgage broker but offers a bespoke solution for larger, more complex real estate transactions

facts.fact: LOAN RANGE (current): focuses on loans of GBP 500k to GBP 20m secured on assets throughout the UK and abroad; current site says it specialises in loans over GBP 500,000.
facts.source: WebSearch summaries, queries 1 and 7 (attribution mixed, partly OWN-SITE)
facts.verbatim: focuses on loans of £500k – £20m, secured on assets throughout the UK and abroad

facts.fact: LOAN RANGE (older third-party listings): commercial mortgage broker focused on large loans of GBP 2m to GBP 20m, offering tailored commercial finance, lender relationships and expert funding advice. CONTRADICTION with the GBP 500k floor on the current site - older listings appear to reflect an earlier positioning.
facts.source: Third-party directory listings (mortgage118 / GoSimples / syob) via WebSearch summary, queries 5 and 7
facts.verbatim: London-based commercial mortgage broker focused on large loans of £2m to £20m, with access to tailored commercial finance, lender relationships and expert funding advice
